description: This PHP source file defines the StoriesAdminController class, which manages CRUD operations and routing for story entities within the admin interface of the Goteo project. It includes methods for listing, editing, and deleting stories, and interacts with various models, forms, and routing components.

classes.name: StoriesAdminController
classes.description: Controller class for managing stories in the admin panel, including listing, editing, and deleting story entries.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'main' for routing or categorization.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines and returns the routing configuration for story management actions.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles the logic for listing stories with optional search filters and pagination.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles creating, editing, and deleting stories, including form processing and validation.
